candidate.name: Sharan Deepak R B
candidate.headline: Fullstack Software Engineer with 3 years of experience implementing and scaling 0→1 product features for 300,000+ active users.
candidate.summary: Fullstack Software Engineer with 3 years of experience implementing and scaling 0→1 product features for 300,000+ active users. Skilled in TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Node.js and Spring Boot, with strengths in API design, database modeling and performance optimization. Proven track record of owning end-to-end solutions, mentoring small teams and collaborating across the software development lifecycle.

highlights: Led full stack development by owning and scaling backend systems for employee engagement products serving 300,000+ active users across 250+ customers, including enterprise deployments with up to 50,000 employees.
Mentored engineers in a 3-member team, driving code quality through reviews and accelerating delivery across backend and mobile initiatives.
Architected and deployed the One-on-Ones module from 0→1 by designing APIs, database schema, and backend services, delivering a scalable multi-tenant system end-to-end.

Built a Reward Marketplace with responsive design using HTML, CSS, and React by designing redemption workflows, voucher lifecycle management, and third-party integrations for transactional systems at scale.
Reduced dashboard latency by 60% by redesigning data access patterns in Spring Boot services and replacing SQL-heavy queries with Elasticsearch.
Increased user engagement by approximately 40% by building event-driven Slack integrations using webhooks and asynchronous backend workflows.

Improved engineering productivity by increasing backend repository AI Agent Readiness from 0% to 85% through LLM-driven architecture including rules, hooks, and sub-agents, enabling developers to automate daily workflows.
Built an internal SDK to streamline communication with CRM services, improving integration consistency across backend workflows.
Developed cron-based automation, queue-driven processing, and cache-backed services to improve reliability and efficiency of scheduled backend operations.

projects.name: Goal Assist
projects.description: Full-stack AI-powered productivity platform using React, Node.js, and TypeScript to connect developer status updates with managerial tracking needs.
highlights: Built a full-stack AI-powered productivity platform using React, Node.js, and TypeScript to address the execution gap between developer status updates and managerial tracking needs.
Designed a responsive React dashboard using HTML, CSS, and accessibility best practices to centralize priorities, task progress, and execution signals.
Automated status tracking through an MCP-powered workflow that captures developer activity and converts it into structured updates, reducing manual task filling and repetitive standup reporting.

projects.name: TicketWise
projects.description: Online ticket reservation system built with Java and Spring Boot, focused on concurrency management, request reliability, and scalable backend service design.
highlights: Developed backend services in Java and Spring Boot to power an online ticket reservation system, implementing RESTful APIs with a focus on concurrency management and service scalability.
Enhanced request reliability under high concurrent traffic by integrating RabbitMQ for asynchronous message-queue processing.
Reduced query latency by integrating OpenSearch-based retrieval patterns in place of slower traditional query flows.
